# P31.14 (SURFACE.1): presentation analytics emitted by the spine export

Implements `docs/tickets/P31.14__presentation-analytics-from-export.md`
(Round 9 Wave B, manifest row 155; `live_verification=false`). Answers
**D-P27.5-1** — the "emit vs presentation-only" question — the export-emitted
way: the spine export now writes a new **`web/analytics/`** artifact family for
every presentation analytic the surfaces render. Stacked on the P31.13 tip
`devin/p31-13-accountability-breadth-ccops-fema` (PR #150).

## Summary

- **`exports/analytics.py`** — pure producers over one shaped snapshot +
  supplementary reads, emitting five files under `web/analytics/`, each with a
  `sig/analytics-*/1` schema id, `as_of`, a **named denominator**,
  `is_population_total: false`, and `source_compartments`:
  - `density_bins` — deterministic **H3 res-3** bins over published **tier-0**
    points only (coordinate reduction applies before aggregation; new `h3`
    dependency since `h3-pg` isn't on the images); `coverage` = distinct named
    sources per cell, so low coverage never renders as low density
    (SIG-UI-018); licence-refused subjects never pad a cell.
  - `centrality` — **undirected degree** over the SAME typed access edges
    (`configured_access` / `observed_use` / `declared_policy`) `network.json`
    emits, materialized first with the shaping fallback; the measure is named
    in the file; `focus` = max degree with a lexical tie-break; `er_quality:
    null` with the inline disclosure that the stat does not rest on a
    probabilistic ER eval (SIG-UI-023).
  - `decision_point` — the earliest derivable `next_decision_date` across the
    renewal watch, the **same rule** the web renders (`resolveTermination`,
    SIG-UI-014b: expiry − notice window when auto-renewing, else expiry) — a
    derived value that can never drift from the dossier; `null` when none is
    derivable.
  - `provenance` — the three per-surface `ProvenanceSummary` blocks; the site
    `tier_distribution` uses the real §10.6 ordinal composition
    (`reconcile.weight.weight_class`, `C` derived per predicate half-life at
    `as_of`, D6 excluded, unweightable → `untiered`), and `human_review_status`
    reads the camera-site review materialization.
  - `queue_meta` — `queue_as_of` + `jurisdiction_claims` (honest `[]` — the
    claim spine does not carry community-curation state, and the denominator
    says so).
- **Licence separation** — each file is labelled like `web/map.json`: a SIG
  CC-BY file lands in `web`; any other single or compound label files in
  `web_mixed` (restricted — a build input of the produced-work site, never a
  public download). `assert_analytics_separated` re-proves one licence per
  compartment; a new `claim_weights` supplementary read feeds the tiers and
  source compartments from the same snapshot.
- **Web seam** — `readAnalytics` validates the envelope and **throws on a
  missing or malformed artifact**, the same fail-loud posture as the nine
  P27.1 surfaces. All nine analytic getters rewired; no DEMO constant or silent
  empty state can reach an export build. `readPresentation` survives only for
  the deliberately-demo `jurisdiction_dossiers`; `ops/publish.py` still refuses
  `web/presentation/` (test-pinned) and partitions `web/analytics/` like every
  other artifact (single-licence public, compound label restricted).
- **Fixture harness** — `build-fixture-export.ts` emits the same envelopes
  with the committed fixture values, so `SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export` exercise stays
  end-to-end in CI.
